title: Super Robot Wars Z II: Hakai-hen Game's Remaster Teased for English Release
content:
The YouTube channel for Bandai Namco Entertainment Southeast Asia began streaming an English version of the announcement video for the Super Robot Wars Z II: Hakai-hen remaster on Monday. The video teases that Bandai Namco Entertainment will release the game in English under the title Super Robot Wars Z II Ruination Remastered .

Bandai Namco Entertainment announced the remaster on Sunday, August 2. The original Super Robot Wars Z II: Hakai-hen game debuted in two parts on the PlayStation Portable. Hakai-hen launched in 2011 and Saisei-hen launched in April 2012.

Super Robot Wars Y , the latest game in the series, launched in August 2025 for PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam .

title: New Digimon Anime Project to Air in 2027
content:
The staff for the Digimon franchise's anime series announced on Saturday that a new anime project is launching for broadcast next year.

Also as part of the 30th anniversary celebration, Fuji TV will begin airing the favorite episodes from the first four Digimon anime, as voted by fans from around the world, on October 4 at 9:00 a.m. (October 3 at 7:00 p.m. EDT).

DIGIMON BEATBREAK , the new television anime for the Digimon franchise, began its "Kyō Arc" with the anime's 38th episode on July 12. The anime premiered on Fuji TV and other channels on October 5. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as it airs, and it is also streaming an English dub .

The first Digital Monster digital pet toys went on sale in 1997, and the first Digimon Adventure television anime series premiered in 1999. The Digimon Adventure 02 sequel anime series then aired in 2000-2001. The 50-episode Digimon Frontier anime aired in Japan from April 2002 to March 2003. The Digimon Ghost Game anime premiered in October 2021, and ended with its 68th episode in March 2023.

title: Kamome Maruyono's I Love Dokagui! Mochizuki-san Manga Gets TV Anime
content:
TOHO animation announced on Tuesday that Kamome Maruyono 's Dokagui Daisuki! Mochizuki-san ( I Love Dokagui! Mochizuki-san ) manga is receiving a television anime adaptation. Animation Studio Passione is producing the anime. TOHO revealed the anime adaptation at the end of a one-hour cooking video loop that started streaming on Tuesday.

Maruyono also drew an illustration to celebrate the announcement:

The gourmet gag comedy manga centers around Mochizuki, who is always craving food in rich, heaping portions.

The ongoing manga launched simultaneously in Hakusensha 's Young Animal Zero magazine and Young Animal Web manga site in May 2024. Hakusensha published the manga's first compiled book volume in October 2024, will publish the fourth volume on September 29.

The manga was nominated in the 18th Manga Taisho awards in 2025, and was included on the list of top 20 manga for male readers in the 2026 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook.

The manga ranked #8 in the top 10 series in the Web Manga category of the Next Manga Awards 2024 (Tsugi ni Kuru Manga Taishō). It was also the inaugural winner of the Next Manga Awards' new "Nichirei Prize" that year.

title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared! Season 2's New Video Unveils More Cast, Opening Song, October Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime of Firehead and YahaKo 's A Wild Last Boss Appeared! light novel series unveiled on Tuesday the second season anime's first promotional video, seven more cast members, returning and new staff members, and October premiere. The video also announces and previews the new season's opening theme song "Melodic Impact" by the rock band Suspended 4th .

The newly announced cast members are:

Ryōta Suzuki as Karkinos

Chiaki Takahashi as Scorpius

Takahiro Sakurai as Castor

Shinpachi Tsuji as Mizar

Momoko Seto as Mass-Produced Libra

Yūichirō Umehara as Terra

M.A.O as Luna

Yūya Horiuchi returns to direct the second season at the studio Wao World , and Kazuyuki Fudeyasu is again in charge of the series scripts. The first season's character designer Maiko Ebisawa returns, but the first season's episode chief animation directors Tōko Nakamura , Takashi Kobayashi , Shōta Ueno , Mamiko Mizutani , and Takahiro Miura are also designing characters for the new season, along with new character designer Akiko Satō .

Additional returning staff members include:

• Color Key Artist: Tomoko Kohioki

• Art Director: Yukari Yasuda

• Compositing Director of Photography: Norimasa Teramoto

• Editing: Rina Koguchi

• Sound Director: Sōichirō Kubo

• Sound Production: Tohokushinsha Film Corporation

• Music: TECHNOBOYS PULCRAFT GREEN-FUND

The anime's second season will debut in October on the Tokyo MX , BS Asahi , and Kansai TV channels. The anime will stream one week before its broadcast on the ABEMA and U-NEXT streaming services.

The staff describes the anime:

In the year 2800 of the Mizgard calendar, Rufus Mafarl — feared as the Black-Winged Conqueror — faces his final battle against the heroes known as the Seven Heroes. After an intense fight, his reign of domination comes to an end. Though peace seemed to have returned with his sealing, the balance of power collapses, leaving the world threatened by the devilfolk. 200 years later — in a desperate attempt to fight back, humanity summons a new hero. But instead, the overlord Lufas awakens from his long seal!But peace was short-lived, as the collapse of the power balance gave rise to a new threat—devilfolk.

The anime stars:

• Ami Koshimizu as Lufas Maphaahl

• Yuri Usui as Dina

• Yukina Shutō as Aries

• Hisako Tōjō as Libra

• Naoya Uchida as Aigokeros

• Mika Kanai as Parthenos

• Kokoro Ōmori as Virgo

• Shunsuke Takeuchi as Sword King Alioth

• Tomoaki Maeno as Wise King Megrez

• Daisuke Hirakawa as Sky King Merak

• Satomi Akesaka as Vampire Princess Benetnasch

The first season initially streamed on ABEMA and U-NEXT in September 2025, and then aired on Tokyo MX , BS Asahi , and Kansai TV in October 2025.

Firehead and YahaKo launched A Wild Last Boss Appeared! ( Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta! ) story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō (Let's Be Novelists) website in 2015, and the series ended in 2017. Earth Star Entertainment published the ninth and final light novel volume in print in April 2019. J-Novel Club released the novel series digitally in English.

Manga artist Tsubasa Hazuki launched a manga adaptation on the Comic Earth Star manga website in 2017. J-Novel Club is also publishing the manga in English. The book franchise has 1.4 million copies in circulation.

title: Dokagui Daisuki Mochizuki-san Comedy Gourmet Anime Adaptation Announced by Toho
content:
TOHO animation has revealed its latest anime project to be an adaptation of Kamome Maruyono’s Dokagui Daisuki Mochizuki-san (stylized as Dokagui Daisuki! Mochizuki-san ) comedy gourmet manga series. The project was teased yesterday with the words “food terror is coming,” likely referring to the 1-hour video of real life cooking that was released leading up to the announcement.

You can see the announcement illustration below.

Dokagui Daisuki! Mochizuki-san is a Japanese seinen manga created by Kamome Maruyono. The story follows Mikoto Mochizuki, a woman with intense enthusiasm for eating enormous quantities of food. The manga first began in Hakusensha’s Young Animal Zero magazine and on the Young Animal Web platform in May 2024, later getting collected tankobon editions.

The series quickly attracted attention for its unusual premise and exaggerated depiction of binge eating. It has appeared in several manga rankings and award programs, including the Next Manga Awards, Manga Taisho, the EbookJapan Manga Awards, and Kono Manga ga Sugoi! .

title: Suikoden: The Anime Key Visual Featuring Five Main Characters Revealed
content:
Suikoden: The Anime , the anime adaptation of Suikoden II , revealed a new key visual featuring the five main characters. The anime was previously announced in March 2025 as an adaptation of Suikoden II , along with a new mobile game for the franchise. It was previously confirmed that Episode 1 will be a 1-hour special.

The anime recently expanded the voice cast with three more members, and it now includes:

• Toshiki Kumagai as Riou

• Ayumi Hinohara as Nanami

• Simba Tsuchiya as Jowy Atreides

• Akihiro Mine as Rowd

• Tsukino Chikasada as Pilika

• Ayumu Murase as Luc

• Takeo Otsuka as Shu

• Yoshino Aoyama as Apple

• Masato Niwa as Mukumuku

• Taku Yashiro as Luca Blight

• Chika Anzai as Jillia Blight

• Jun Kasama as Culgan

• Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Seed

• Megumi Han as Leknaat

• Shota Hayama as Gengen

• Ryunosuke Watanuki as Rikimaru

• Saaya Hitomi as Rina

• Mizutama Umino as Eilie

• Yusuke Sasaki as Bolgan

• Hitoshi Yamanoi as Agares Blight

• Miyuki Sawashiro as Anabelle

• Hiroki Sakai as Jess

The company’s recently-established in-house studio KONAMI animation is handling the animation production, with Yuzo Sato as the director. Steam describes the story of the second game:

Our story’s hero and his friend Jowy are members of the Unicorn Youth Brigade, which participated in a drawn-out border dispute between the Highland Kingdom and the City-States of Jowston . A few months earlier, a truce agreement was signed between the two forces, both of which were happy to see an end to the fighting. However, hidden under the momentary peace the fires of a new war continued to smolder…

Production Details

• Original Work: Konami Digital Entertainment

• Director: Yuzo Sato

• Production & Planning: KONAMI animation

• Production Committee: Suikoden Production Committee

Originally released in 1998 as part of the Suikoden series, Suikoden II is a turn-based RPG developed by Konami Digital Entertainment. The game follows a young hero caught in a war between rival nations and is known for its large cast of recruitable characters, political narrative, and tactical battles.

title: 'Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta! 2nd Season' Reveals Additional Cast, Opening Theme, First Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Firehead 's Yasei no Last Boss ga Arawareta! ( A Wild Last Boss Appeared! ) light novel revealed additional cast, the opening theme, and first promotional video for the second season on Tuesday. The new season is scheduled to premiere on Tokyo MX, BS Asahi, and Kansai TV in October 2026.

Cast Karkinos: Ryouta Suzuki ( Dr. Stone: Science Future ) Scorpius: Chiaki Takahashi ( Gintama ) Castor: Takahiro Sakurai ( Mob Psycho 100 ) Mizal: Shinpachi Tsuji ( Nippon Sangoku ) Mass Production Libra: Momoko Seto ( Mayonaka Heart Tune ) Terra: Yuuichirou Umehara ( Goblin Slayer ) Luna: Mao Ichimichi ( Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken )

Japanese rock band Suspended 4th is performing the opening theme "Melodic Impact," which is previewed in the promotional video below.

Yuuya Horiuchi ( Nijiyon Animation ) is directing the anime at WAO World , with Kazuyuki Fudeyasu ( Black Clover ) handling the series composition. Maiko Ebisawa ( Undead Unluck animation director) is designing the characters. Technoboys Pulcraft Green-Fund ( Kakegurui ) is composing the music.

Produced by WAO World, the first season aired as a 12-episode series in Fall 2025. Crunchyroll simulcast the anime with subtitles and later with dubs in multiple languages.

Firehead began penning the action fantasy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in October 2015. Earth Star Entertainment later acquired the series and began publishing the light novel in print under its Earth Star Novel imprint with illustrations by YahaKo in February 2016. The ninth and final volume was published in April 2019.

Tsubasa Hazuki began drawing a manga adaptation in Comic Earth☆Star in June 2017. Earth Star Entertainment shipped the 11th volume in November 2025.

J-Novel Club licensed both the light novel and manga in English for digital release in April 2020 and January 2024, respectively. The light novel's ninth and final volume was released in July 2022, and the tenth manga volume went on sale on April 22.

title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared Season 2 Reveals First Trailer, New Cast, October 2026 Release
content:
A Wild Last Boss Appeared has revealed its first Season 2 trailer, confirming that the anime will return in October 2026. The new preview also features the opening theme by Suspended 4th and introduces several new characters. The sequel was announced immediately after the first season’s finale.

The opening theme song is “Melodic Impact” by Japanese rock band Suspended 4th. Season 2 introduces seven additional cast members:

• Ryota Suzuki as Karkinos

• Chiaki Takahashi as Scorpius

• Takahiro Sakurai as Castor

• Shinpachi Tsuji as Mizar

• Momoko Seto as Libra

• Yuichiro Umehara as Terra

• M.A.O as Luna

You can watch the new trailer below.

Including the director Yuya ‌Horiuchi, the main staff for the A Wild Last Boss Appeared anime consists of the following members:

• Director: Yuya Horiuchi

• Series Composition: Kazuyuki Fudeyasu

• Original Character Design: Yahako

• Character Design: Maiko Ebisawa

• Sub Character Design: Takashi Kobayashi, Shota Ueno

• Producer: WOWMAX

• Animation Studio: WAO World

Firehead writes the A Wild Last Boss Appeared (Yasei no Rasu Bosu ga Arawareta) light novel series, which features illustrations by YahaKo. It first began on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website in October 2015, with Earth Star Entertainment publishing a print edition under their Earth Star Novel imprint from February 2016. Both ended on April 15, 2019. There is also a manga adaptation by Tsubasa Hazuki, which began serialization on Earth Star Entertainment’s Comic Earth Star website in June 2017 and is currently ongoing. J-Novel Club licensed both the light novel and manga in English. The franchise has surpassed 1.7 million copies in circulation.

The story follows a man who wakes up in the body of his MMO character, Lufas Maphaahl, the feared Black-Winged Tyrant and leader of the Twelve Heavenly Stars, 200 years after her defeat in a player-driven event of the game Exgate Online . But this is no longer a game, but rather it’s reality. With her reign long past and her name remembered only in fear, Lufas now navigates a different world, looking for answers, allies, and a way to confront the chaos and monsters that her “death” left behind.

title: Super Psychic Policeman Chojo Anime Reveals October 6 TV Debut
content:
The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for the television anime of Shun Numa 's Super Psychic Policeman Chojo ( Chōjun! Chōjō Senpai ) manga announced on Tuesday that the anime will premiere on Kansai TV , Fuji TV , and affiliated channels throughout Japan on October 6 at 11:00 p.m. (10:00 a.m. EDT).

Viz Media and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service started publishing chapters of the manga simultaneously with the Japan release in February 2024. MANGA Plus describes the series:

The creator of Samon the Summoner returns to Jump with a new series about a super-powered policeman! In Chinjuku, the city that never sleeps, there is a psychic senior police officer who has powers beyond human comprehension! His name is Meguru Chojo! Along with his judo expert partner Nao Ippongi, this hilarious duo will keep the streets clean by any means necessary!

Junichi Yamamoto ( Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion ; Maebashi Witches ; Anyway, I'm Falling in Love with You ) is directing the anime at Arvo Animation . Hayashi Mori ( Sand Land: The Series , Cells at Work! Code Black , Onmyo Kaiten Re:Birth Verse ) is superivsing and writing series scripts, and Masakatsu Sasaki ( 16bit Sensation: Another Layer , Seiyu's Life! , TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You ) is designing the characters.

Junichi Yamamoto ( Why Raeliana Ended Up at the Duke's Mansion ; Maebashi Witches ; Anyway, I'm Falling in Love with You ) is directing the anime at Arvo Animation . Hayashi Mori ( Sand Land: The Series , Cells at Work! Code Black , Onmyo Kaiten Re:Birth Verse ) is superivsing and writing series scripts, and Masakatsu Sasaki ( 16bit Sensation: Another Layer , Seiyu's Life! , TONIKAWA: Over The Moon For You ) is designing the characters.
